subject.title: Agent model hot-reload (agents.<id>.model.primary) silently doesn't take effect; fresh threads inherit stale model

question: Should an `agents.<id>.model.primary` hot reload move existing unpinned sessions and parent-created threads to the new default model, or should OpenClaw preserve sticky session model fields and warn that those sessions need a reset or restart?
rationale: Current source can support either product behavior, but changing sticky session model fields affects upgrade/session compatibility and should be an explicit maintainer decision.

options.title: Apply to unpinned sessions
options.body: Invalidate or update only default-derived `modelProvider`/`model` state for the affected agent while preserving explicit `providerOverride`/`modelOverride` pins.

options.title: Warn and preserve stickiness
options.body: Keep current sticky session behavior but change the applied reload message and docs/diagnostics so operators know existing sessions and inherited threads need reset or restart.

options.title: Close as intentional
options.body: Declare session model stickiness the supported behavior and document that config model changes apply only to sessions without runtime model state.

recommendation.title: Apply to unpinned sessions
recommendation.body: Invalidate or update only default-derived `modelProvider`/`model` state for the affected agent while preserving explicit `providerOverride`/`modelOverride` pins.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent config reload/runtime snapshot work is the closest merged owner signal for this stale-runtime-config area.
